text: アツコと　ポケモンとりで　まちあわせって…　とりポケモンが　みつからない！

structure.jp: ポケモンとりで　まちあわせって…
とりポケモンが　みつからない！
structure.en: I can't find any bird Pokémon!

patterns.name: 〜って (quoting)
patterns.explanation: って is the casual way to repeat what someone said, like と in careful speech; the 'said' is left out. ポケモンとりで　まちあわせって = 'we were told to meet at Pokémon-tori'.

patterns.name: 〜と (with)
patterns.explanation: と after a person means together with that person. アツコと = 'with Atsuko'.
